title: 第676章 老神仙日常676第675章 老神仙日常675
content_zh:
韩烈气呼呼地回了家，一进家门，听见大哥在打电话。
他将摩托头盔放在了一边，还没过去，便见大哥抬眸看了一眼自己。
微蹙着眉头，他喊了一声，“大哥。”
韩刚点了点头，说了句“知道了”，径直挂了电话，他大步走到了弟弟身边，一伸胳膊勾住了弟弟的脖子，“想去哪里，怎么不叫司机送你，干嘛要自己骑机车？”
“怎么了？”韩烈蹙起眉来，“我最近不都是……”
韩刚笑着摇了摇头，随意摇了摇手中的电话，“接到警务处的电话啦，说我名下的摩托车，今天早上有人不谨慎驾驶。”
“不谨慎驾驶？”韩烈眉头蹙的更紧了些，“这样的小事，怎么还打电话来？”
“傻弟弟~”韩刚晃了晃弟弟的肩膀，哼哼笑着给了弟弟一个无事了的眼神儿，“怎么样？事情还顺利吗？”
韩烈抿紧了唇不吭声。
韩刚转头去看，见弟弟脸色不好，他渐渐眯起了眼睛，“什么人？居然敢不给我们姓韩的面子。”
“大哥~”韩烈喊了一声，却见大哥脸色越发阴沉起来，他急忙说道，“大哥，你让我自己解决啦。”
韩刚闭上了眼睛，睁眼时朝着弟弟露出个笑来，“小烈，家里的事情你不要管，去做你想做的事情。不过，要是谁敢得罪你，大哥不会让他好过。”
韩烈垂眸，抬手拉住了大哥的胳膊，“那辆车是我早上开的，可我没有闯红灯呀？”
“不是闯红灯，”韩刚忽然笑了起来，“接到行人投诉，说什么车速过快，泥点子什么的……”
韩烈被气笑，“谁这么多事？！”
韩刚摇头，用拇指指了指身后，“我找人去查。”
“算啦，”韩烈摇头，深吸了一口气，“警务处怎么说？我要什么时候去重新学习？”
“什么你去？！”韩刚揉了揉弟弟的头发，“自然有小弟去。”
韩烈咧了咧嘴角。
“阿刚、小烈，你们老爸马上进家门了，”林缱指挥着佣人将煮好的午饭摆上了桌，回头见兄弟两个还在磨蹭，不由开口催促，“难得你爸爸有时间回来，陪咱们吃饭。”

“林姨，马上就来。”韩烈喊了这声，回手拉住了韩刚的胳膊，笑着喊了声，“大哥。”
“你呀~”韩刚用力揉了揉弟弟的脑袋，瞟了一眼林缱，小声说道，“十几年了，什么时候才肯开口喊声小妈？”
韩烈愣怔了一瞬，勾着唇角拉着大哥大步走了过去。
下午两点，林彦廷结束了午休，从专属休息室里走了出来，“may，一会儿陈先生来了，你帮我将早上脏了的衬衫送到干洗店去。”
may点了点头，她知道这是林医生给她的福利，送了衬衫，她便可以下班回家了。
仰着脸露出个笑容来，开口提醒道，“明天比较忙，早上有两个客人，下午有一个。”
林彦廷点了点头，转身走进诊室去。
下午结束了工作，林彦廷将陈先生从诊室里送了出来，刚开口寒暄了一句，便看见may的座位上多了一个人。
韩烈起身，唇角上又挂上了个假笑，“doctor
林，我帮你送客人离开。”
林彦廷挑眉，挥了挥手，说了声，“不用。”
content_en:
Han Lie returned home angrily. As soon as he entered the house, he heard his elder brother talking on the phone.
He put his motorcycle helmet aside, and before he could pass by, he saw his elder brother looking up at him.
Frowning slightly, he shouted, "Brother."
Han Gang nodded, said "I know," and hung up the phone. He strode to his brother's side, stretched out his arm and hooked his neck, "Where do you want to go? Why don't you ask the driver to take you there? Why do you have to ride a motorcycle by yourself?"
"What's wrong?" Han Lie frowned, "I haven't been..."
Han Gang smiled and shook his head, casually shaking the phone in his hand, "I received a call from the police department, saying that someone was driving the motorcycle in my name carelessly this morning."
"Driving carelessly?" Han Lie frowned even more tightly, "Why did you call me for such a trivial matter?"
"Silly brother~" Han Gang shook his younger brother's shoulders, hummed and smiled and gave his younger brother a look that said nothing was wrong, "How is it? Is everything going well?"
Han Lie pursed his lips and remained silent.
Han Gang turned around to look, and when he saw his younger brother's expression turned ugly, he gradually narrowed his eyes, "Who is he? How dare he not give us the honor of being named Han."
"Brother~" Han Lie shouted, but saw that his eldest brother's face became more and more gloomy. He hurriedly said, "Brother, you let me solve it myself."
Han Gang closed his eyes and smiled at his younger brother when he opened them, "Xiao Lie, don't worry about things at home and do what you want to do. However, if anyone dares to offend you, my eldest brother will not make it easy for him."
Han Lie lowered his eyes and raised his hand to hold his elder brother's arm, "I drove that car in the morning, but I didn't run the red light?"
"It's not about running a red light," Han Gang suddenly laughed, "I received complaints from pedestrians about driving too fast, nonsense, etc..."
Han Lie laughed angrily, "Who is so troubled?!"
Han Gang shook his head and pointed behind him with his thumb, "I'll find someone to check."
"Forget it," Han Lie shook his head and took a deep breath, "What did the police say? When do I need to study again?"
"Why are you going?!" Han Gang rubbed his younger brother's hair, "Of course my younger brother will go."
Han Lie grinned.
"A Gang, Xiao Lie, your dad is coming into the house soon," Lin Xian directed the servants to put the cooked lunch on the table. Looking back, he saw the two brothers were still dilly-dallying, so he couldn't help but urge, "It's rare that your dad has time to come back and eat with us."
"Aunt Lin, you'll be here soon." Han Lie called out, then pulled Han Gang's arm and shouted with a smile, "Brother."
"You~" Han Gang rubbed his brother's head vigorously, glanced at Lin Xian, and whispered, "It's been more than ten years, when will you be willing to call me mom?"
Han Lie was stunned for a moment, then pulled his eldest brother over with his lips curled up.
At two o'clock in the afternoon, Lin Yanting finished his lunch break and walked out of the exclusive lounge, "May, Mr. Chen will be here later. Please help me take the dirty shirts this morning to the dry cleaners."
May nodded. She knew that this was a benefit that Dr. Lin gave her. After giving her a shirt, she could go home from get off work.
He raised his face with a smile and reminded, "Tomorrow will be busy. There are two guests in the morning and one in the afternoon."
Lin Yanting nodded, turned around and walked into the consulting room.
After finishing his work in the afternoon, Lin Yanting sent Mr. Chen out of the consulting room. As soon as he exchanged greetings, he saw an extra person sitting in May's seat.
Han Lie stood up with another fake smile on his lips, "Doctor
Lin, let me help you send the guests away. "
Lin Yanting raised his eyebrows, waved his hand, and said, "No need."
